profile.title: Civil Engineer building AI tools for contract management
profile.currentRole: Project Management Office Chief at Tasyapi Construction, working on the Kuzmin–Sremska Rača Highway (€345M) in Serbia since 2024.
profile.summary: Furkan Şenyüz is a Civil Engineer (BSc) who has worked on mega infrastructure projects across Europe, including the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge, the Northern Marmara Motorway and the Aydın-Denizli Motorway. He specializes in FIDIC contract management, claim-file preparation (EOT and cost claims), planning and cost control (Primavera P6, TILOS) and international tendering across 10+ countries. He is also an civil engineer who builds AI tools for contract management who applies Machine Learning and Python to automate construction workflows such as invoice auditing, IPC/RFI checks, tender-dossier analysis and BOQ pricing.

projects.name: DCC — Document Intelligence Platform
projects.description: RAG platform over ~24,000 FIDIC project letters — hybrid pgvector search, claim threading and a Gemini chat assistant. Deployed and in daily use for document control on the Kuzmin–Sremska Rača project.

projects.name: Invoice Audit System
projects.description: Cross-checks supplier invoices against weighbridge and site records — flags quantity and price mismatches automatically. In daily use.

projects.name: IPC × RFI Check
projects.description: Validates interim payment certificate (IPC) quantities against approved RFIs before submission.

projects.name: Tender Brief Analyzer
projects.description: Reads full tender dossiers and produces page-referenced, decision-ready participation briefs.

projects.name: BOQ & Unit Price Analyzer
projects.description: Automated unit-rate build-ups and BOQ pricing analysis for tender costing.

projects.name: Concrete Strength Prediction
projects.description: ML model predicting concrete compressive strength from mix design, with a TS EN 206-1 compliance layer. Live in-browser demo at furkansenyuz.com/beton-dayanimi-tahmini/demo/ plus a Medium article and public GitHub repo.
